title: Captured clock tape as a zipper
statement: For every bit word $w$, its captured clock tape equals the tape formed by a zipper with frontier at coordinate $1$, left list consisting of the origin marker, and right list consisting of the symbols of $w$ encoded as bit symbols.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is an arbitrary finite bit word
replaced:
For every bit word $w$, the captured clock tape of $w$ (origin sentinel at cell $0$,
the bits of $w$ on cells $1,\dots,|w|$, blanks elsewhere) equals the zipper tape with
frontier at cell $1$, left list consisting of the single origin sentinel, and right
list the bits of $w$, each encoded as a budget-bit symbol.
